subject: The secret truth about couples who never run out of ideas
preview_text: You're now part of the 230+ who discovered this relationship hack. Most couples make this one mistake...
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. For years, I thought planning dates was something you did alone or with your partner in quiet frustration. Turns out, I was completely wrong. And so are 90% of couples who think date planning is a solo mission.

Here's what I discovered: The couples who never run out of steam, who keep that spark alive month after month, they do things differently. They've formed a quiet little tribe. They share their wins, their weird date ideas, their 'remember when' moments. They're not just planning dates—they're building a shared language of love. And you're now part of that group. 230+ couples strong, all refusing to let routine win.

That's why the Date History feature in SoulPlan isn't just a log. It's your tribe's storybook. Every date you log becomes part of your unique love language. It's the proof that you're different. That you're part of the small percentage who decided to show up intentionally for each other.

Open the app right now and look at your Date History. See your story building. Then add today's date—even if it's just coffee on the couch. Keep writing your chapter. P.S. The couples who use Date History weekly are 3x more likely to say their relationship improved. That's not a coincidence—it's your new normal.
